landing.name: Ezra Wanyama Waswa
landing.tagline: "Turn your phone into a super computer"
aboutParagraphs: Ezra Wanyama Waswa, popularly known as "THE SMARTPHONE SCIENTIST," is a Kenyan innovator, tech developer, and computer science student.

Operating without a traditional laptop, Ezra converts standard Android hardware into a high-powered technical workstation using Termux, Pydroid, and GitHub to engineer full-stack web platforms, databases, and AI systems.
landing.philosophy: Continuous learning and turning your phone into a super computer.

projects.name: Navakholo TerraHub Initiative
projects.why: To drive grassroots economic growth, community skilling, and digital sovereignty in Kakamega County.
projects.solved: Provides a decentralized digital ecosystem and community blueprints bridging the digital divide.
